candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe hard for body and this one don last for 3 days. No sign say e dey convulse now, e never get convulsion before, e no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. I count e breath for one minute and na 35 breaths. Pikin chest no dey draw inside. As I dey check am, pikin dey calm. I no get pulse oximeter. E no get recurrent wheeze, e no dey wheeze, but as e dey calm, I see stridor. Pikin no get diarrhoea, no ear problem, no fever.
